thesis_titles.official_registered_title: Targeting Experimentally Induced Arthritis in Rats Using Selected Natural Products as Glucocorticoid-Sparing Agents
thesis_titles.presentation_defense_title: Evaluating Micronized Palmitoylethanolamide (m-PEA) as a Glucocorticoid-Sparing Strategy in Adjuvant-Induced Arthritis in Wistar Rats

operational_and_budgetary_constraints.facility_status: Under-equipped local university facilities (No liquid nitrogen at sacrifice, no continuous cold-chain transit, no automated in-house ELISA/molecular suites)
operational_and_budgetary_constraints.assay_execution: Mandatory outsourcing to external referral laboratories in Cairo or Tanta
operational_and_budgetary_constraints.specimen_prioritization: Durable FFPE paraffin blocks and aliquoted frozen serum
operational_and_budgetary_constraints.forbidden_recommendations: Expensive fragile molecular panels (RT-qPCR arrays, phospho-p38 Western blots, RNA extraction from decalcified bone)

clinical_bottleneck.pathology: Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) - chronic autoimmune systemic polyarthritis
hallmarks: Cartilage matrix degradation and proteoglycan erosion
molecular_drivers: NF-κB (p65/RelA) hyperactivation driving TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, and iNOS
p38 MAPK phosphorylation (Thr180/Tyr182) inducing MMP-1, MMP-3, MMP-13, and ADAMTS-5
clinical_bottleneck.steroid_toxicity_crisis: Chronic full-dose glucocorticoid therapy (Prednisolone >=10 mg/kg) produces debilitating adverse effects: secondary osteoporosis, severe hyperglycemia/steroid diabetes, muscle wasting, and HPA-axis suppression.

therapeutic_solution.pharmacological_class: Autacoid Local Inflammation Antagonist (ALIAmide); endogenous N-acylethanolamine (NAE)
therapeutic_solution.formulation_source: Limitless PEA Egyptian commercial tablets finely pulverized into a micronized aqueous suspension in 0.5% CMC-Na vehicle
therapeutic_solution.steroid_sparing_hypothesis: Co-administration of m-PEA allows a 50% dose reduction of Prednisolone (from 10 mg/kg down to 5 mg/kg) while maintaining full or superior anti-inflammatory efficacy and abolishing steroid toxicities.

cytosolic_clamp_pea.mechanism: Direct PPAR-α agonism drives non-canonical transactivation of the NFKBIA promoter (encoding IκBα), replenishing cytoplasmic IκBα pools to permanently sequester the NF-κB p65/p50 heterodimer in the cytosol.

nuclear_clamp_prednisolone.mechanism: Ligand-activated GR-α translocates to the nucleus, tethers residual chromatin-bound p65 monomers, and recruits HDAC2 to de-acetylate histones, epigenetically silencing inflammatory cytokine genes (TNF, IL1B, IL6).

mapk_phosphatase_convergence.mechanism: Both PPAR-α and GR-α independently transactivate the DUSP1 promoter, causing robust MKP-1 dephosphorylation of phospho-p38 MAPK at Thr180/Tyr182, arresting chondrocyte apoptosis and cartilage matrix degradation.

animal_specifications.housing: Standard pathogen-free conditions (22±2°C, 12h light/dark cycle), ad libitum rodent chow and water

induction_protocol.composition: 1 mg/mL heat-killed Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra suspended in sterile paraffin oil

timeline.days_16_to_45: Therapeutic phase: 30 consecutive days of daily oral gavage treatment
timeline.day_46: Terminal sacrifice, cardiac puncture blood harvest, bilateral knee joint and ankle excision

law_1_pilot_quarantine.mandate: STRICT SCIENTIFIC QUARANTINE. The pilot study was an exploratory screening of n=2 rats per group. NEVER cite pilot numbers as final confirmatory thesis results, and NEVER pool pilot data into literature meta-analyses. Always retain [!WARNING] quarantine callouts.

law_2_ground_truth_precedence.mandate: The primary research records in '00-Sources/' represent the ultimate empirical ground truth if any conflict arises.

law_3_zettelkasten_link_integrity.mandate: All cross-references must use standard bidirectional Obsidian wikilinks. Zero dead links are permitted in the entire vault.

law_4_zero_hallucination.mandate: Zero fabrication of DOIs, authors, or experimental findings. Every scientific statement must resolve to canonical literature or official protocol records.
